decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing quick and aggressive creatures to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. By combining creatures with abilities that boost their power and utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage and Titan's Strength to deal extra damage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck, allowing for additional mana ramp and potential for stronger plays.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks. By utilizing cheap, hasty creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, combined with pump spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides a versatile mana source and additional value. The deck focuses on speed, aggression, and efficient creature combat to quickly take down opponents in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly casting spells and utilizing cards like Arclight Phoenix and Ledger Shredder to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower to control the board and protect key cards. The deck's goal is to fuel the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times and overwhelm the opponent with a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to both red and blue mana sources.

The main concept of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing tempo plays to disrupt their game plan. By utilizing cards like Spell Queller and Mausoleum Wanderer to counter spells and protect your creatures, as well as cards like Skyclave Apparition to remove threats from the board, the deck aims to control the game while quickly building a board presence with Spirit creatures. The addition of disruptive spells like Portable Hole and The Wandering Emperor further adds to the deck's ability to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain pressure on them.

This Boros Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and board control. The deck includes removal spells like Lightning Helix and Torch the Tower, along with cards that generate value such as Wedding Announcement and Caretaker's Talent. The deck also features a mix of aggressive threats like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and defensive options like Sunfall and High Noon. The mana base supports the deck's strategy by providing access to a variety of colors and utility lands to control the board and outvalue the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays to overwhelm opponents quickly. With a mix of burn spells, creatures with haste, and pump effects, the deck aims to deal damage early and often. The creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary can come down quickly and hit hard, while cards like Light Up the Stage and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional card advantage. By applying constant pressure and taking advantage of quick mana sources, this deck looks to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements and a high density of removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes powerful creatures like Lotus Cobra and Nissa, Resurgent Animist to generate mana and gain card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents like Glarb, Calamity's Augur and Fecund Greenshell. The deck also aims to ramp into strong late-game threats like Cyclonic Rift and The World Tree to close out the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like March of Otherworldly Light, Get Lost, and Settle the Wreckage. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi provide additional control elements and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control strategy, allowing for efficient casting of spells while also providing some flexibility in terms of color requirements.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards such as Consider and Sleight of hand to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck utilizes cheap instants and sorceries to trigger the Phoenix's ability, along with controlling spells like Brazen Borrower and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Treasure Cruise helps with card draw and Prof's Eidetic Memory can be used as a win condition. The mana base is focused on producing blue and red mana efficiently to cast spells consistently.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to play aggressively with low-cost creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear, boosting them with combat tricks like Defiant Strike and Titan's Strength. The deck also utilizes protection spells like Shardmage's Rescue and Sheltered by Ghosts to keep the creatures on the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional source of mana acceleration. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and efficient combat tricks to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously tutor for powerful creatures and enchantments to control the board. It utilizes a variety of versatile creatures and enchantments to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while providing a steady stream of threats to win the game. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value from blinking creatures and enchantments. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the deck's diverse range of cards.

This deck focuses on countering opponent's spells while controlling the board with removal and disruption. It aims to outsmart the opponent with card advantage and strategic plays, utilizing a mix of instant speed spells and creatures with disruptive abilities. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure mana consistency for casting spells of different colors. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and maintaining control of the battlefield, this deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures.

This Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing out evasive Spirit creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom, while utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By protecting its creatures with spells like Sheltered by Ghosts and Geistlight Snare, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly. Curious Obsession provides card advantage, while Invasion of Gobakhan helps to push through damage. Mutavault and other lands provide additional utility and mana fixing for the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Valgavoth, Terror Eater and Hidetsugu Consumes All. It includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the game and ensure the combo goes off smoothly. Fatal Push and Torch the Tower provide removal options while Reckoner Bankbuster deals with problematic artifacts. The deck also includes card draw and recursion with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card advantage to outlast and outmaneuver opponents. By leveraging counterspells like Dovin's Veto and removal like Settle the Wreckage, along with card draw from Memory Deluge and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria provides additional card advantage and powerful abilities, while versatile spells like Supreme Verdict and March of Otherworldly Light offer flexibility in dealing with different threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's control strategy and maximize consistency.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for card advantage, disruption, and removal to control the game and outvalue opponents. By incorporating powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with counterspells like Dovin's Veto and board wipes such as Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to maintain control of the board and slow down the opponent's game plan. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck also has access to additional resources and resilience to grind out longer games.
